item.title: Not enough time to cross, 26th July
item.description:
These lights do not give enough time to cross. Especially children, disabled and elderly. Often people cross diagonally, a the little amount of time leaves them in a dangerous situation. The crossing is very close to two schools and often busy in the morning. Please give the pedestrians more time, even 5 seconds would make a huge difference.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 2, Alstone Lane, Kingsditch, Cheltenham, Cheltenham

item.title: Dangerously insuffucient space on pavement by bus stop, 26th July
item.description:
Bus stop near alleyway from Derwent Close onto Ermin Street Brockworth. Stop needs to be moved further up to a more safe area. Very testing when trying to manoeuvre a wheelchair, or pushchair to get on the bus, and even harder getting off the bus onto the pavement. Apart from being a favourite dog fouling area, the pavement is a little slanted and very narrow. If the stop was moved 10yds up , it would be a much safer area. Thank you

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 34, Ermin Street, Tewkesbury
